bio.text: Danny Short has represented District 39 in the Delaware House of Representatives since being elected in November 2006.
He served as House Minority Whip from 2008 to 2010 and House Minority Leader from 2012 to 2022.
Before that he was a Seaford city councilman beginning in 1995 and then mayor until March 2006.
Short is a life member of the Seaford Volunteer Fire Department, where he was fire chief, and owns Short Insurance Associates in Seaford.
